Output UI components for the dittoHeatmap module

Source: R/dittoHeatmap_module_ui.R
dittoHeatmapOutputUI.Rd

This should be placed in the UI where the plot should be shown. The heatmap is an InteractiveComplexHeatmap widget, not a plotly figure.

Usage

dittoHeatmapOutputUI(id, resizable = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

id

The ID for the Shiny module.

resizable

Accepted for consistency with the other modules; the widget sizes itself to its container.

...

Passed to VizModules::ComplexHeatmap_HeatmapOutputUI(), e.g. layout or compact.

Value

A Shiny tagList with the heatmap widget.

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

if (requireNamespace("InteractiveComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
    dittoHeatmapOutputUI("heatmap")
}
